correctness.rationale: Orthogonal eigenspace decomposition (multiplicities 1,k-1,k,1 and eigenvalues 0,1,3,2k+1) gives all kernel entries. Its absolute hub and leaf row sums give the exact three functions. The partner coefficient has one monotone-polynomial zero and the hub comparison one strictly-convex-polynomial zero. The inequality 3^k>=2k^2 orders them. Root transversality gives both corners; direct logarithmic root estimates prove separated asymptotics. Matrix rows have sharp sign inputs. checker.py passed 20,235 exact-rational assertions for k=2..10 and six rational heat parameters; the universal claims rely on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The norm measures worst bounded-initial-data amplification of the instantaneous heat diffusion rate, a natural endpoint stability quantity. Friendship graphs are canonical cyclic hub-and-spoke networks, and the exact profile reveals two distinct physically interpretable changes: worst-case site relocation at vanishing log(k)/k time and a persistent local-pair interference sign reversal near log(3)/2. Sharp sign-vector attainment and different asymptotic scales are structural contributions beyond a basic spectral computation. The finding is limited to this natural, explicitly defined family.
